review.reviewBody:
Saltblock catered our summer party in Tampa this month and they did an exceptional job! From start to finish - the quality of both the food and the service were extraordinary.
Parker Skornschek made our event easy and fun. He is an excellent communicator and gave us the party we envisioned. We live in San Francisco and Parker made planning our party "long distance" a delightful experience. His preparation was awesome - he visited the house / location ahead of our arrival and made suggestions that we followed for the food layout. We asked for “California cuisine” and he created a menu that exceeded our expectations. Every dish was tasty, lovely and plentiful. Our guests complimented the delicious food, beautiful display and professional service.
Staff Chef Grace, Lead assistant Akima, Kelly and Yoandra arrived early, prepped, prepared, arranged and served in the most subtle seamless way. Clean-up was fast and impeccable.
We HIGHLY recommend Parker, his team and SaltBlock Hospitality, and we hope to work with them again.
